== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Path]] of Black Flame, also known as the [[Blackflame]] [[Path]], is a specialized art centered on [[pure destruction]]. Stolen from ancient [[Black dragons|black dragons]], the [[Path]] allows its practitioners to imitate draconic power through various techniques. Historically, it was utilized by the [[Blackflame family]] to maintain a massive empire for over five hundred years through overwhelming force. While it is not illegal to practice, the [[Path]] carries significant risks; its [[madra]] can erode a user's physical body, mind, soul, and lifespan, often causing internal damage or madness. Techniques associated with the [[Path]] include the [[Fierce Fire Robe]], an [[Enforcer technique]], and the [[Burning Cloak]], which provides explosive speed. Practitioners often manifest physical changes, such as eyes turning black with red irises, and can utilize specialized forms like [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] or forged claws. The [[Path]] is highly aggressive and destructive, capable of turning matter into ash or dust without leaving molten residue. Although the original [[Blackflame Empire]] has declined following devastation by [[Dreadgods]], the [[Path]] remains a potent and feared force in the empire.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The [[Path]] of Black Flame, also known as the [[Blackflame]] [[Path]], is an art of pure and ruthless destruction that was originally stolen from ancient [[dragons]]. Although people seek to revive this path, it remains a discipline that [[Eithan]] is capable of teaching [[Lindon]]. During the [[Enforcer Trial]], which was specifically designed to test a single disciple on this path, [[Lindon]] had not yet learned any [[Striker techniques]] associated with it.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The [[Path of Black Flame]] was stolen from ancient [[dragons]] and is the art of [[pure destruction]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c1">''Blackflame'', chapter 1</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The [[Path of Black Flame]] is also commonly called the [[Path of Black Flame|Blackflame Path]] or the [[Path of Black Flame]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c9">''Blackflame'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The [[Path of Black Flame|Blackflame Path]] is a path [[Eithan]] can teach [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c10">''Blackflame'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Lindon]] has not learned any [[Striker techniques]] on the [[Path of Black Flame]] yet.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c14">''Blackflame'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The [[Enforcer Trial]] was designed to test a single disciple on the [[Path of Black Flame]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c15">''Blackflame'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The [[Path of Black Flame]] is associated with ruthless destruction.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c15" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The [[Path of Black Flame]] is something people try to revive.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c22">''Blackflame'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The [[Path of Black Flame]] is a path that can be revived.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c22" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|As an offensive [[Path]], the [[Path]] of Black Flame is known for possessing powerful cards and a famous variation of [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]]. Practitioners utilize a basic aura [[cycling technique]] to aid in recovery, which becomes necessary as the damage from the [[Path]] begins to accumulate for [[Lindon]]. Eventually, [[Lindon]]'s specific [[Path]] of Black Flame advances into [[Highgold]].}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Originally absorbed by [[Lindon]] from [[Naian Blackflame|Naian]], the [[Path]] of Black Flame is a power known to erode the user's mind, body, and soul. [[Lindon]] eventually cycles this path, utilizing its ability to punch through formidable defenses. However, the path carries a significant risk, as it can cause a [[Ruler technique]] to detonate if torn between two different spirits.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The [[Path of Black Flame]] is known to erode the mind, body, and soul.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15">''Uncrowned'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|[[Lindon]] cycles the [[Path of Black Flame|Path of the Black Flame]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c16">''Uncrowned'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The [[Path of Black Flame]] is a path that can cause the [[Ruler technique]] to detonate when torn between two spirits.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The [[Path of Black Flame]] needs to be able to punch through strong defenses.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19">''Uncrowned'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The [[Path of Black Flame]] was absorbed by [[Lindon]] from [[Naian Blackflame|Naian]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20">''Uncrowned'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
